title: Project Halyard — Shareholders' agreement (execution version, excerpt)
text:
SHAREHOLDERS' AGREEMENT — PROJECT HALYARD
EXECUTION VERSION — ZWALMVELD BIOPLASTICS NV
Dated 3 September 2026

THIS AGREEMENT is made between:

(1) VLIETMOLEN POLYMERS NV, a naamloze vennootschap incorporated under the laws of Belgium, with registered office at Doorniksesteenweg 415, 8500 Kortrijk, registered with the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises under number 0438.612.917 ("Vlietmolen");

(2) VANTRELL PLASTICS HOLDCO S.à r.l., a société à responsabilité limitée under the laws of Luxembourg, with registered office at 63, boulevard Grande-Duchesse Charlotte, L-1331 Luxembourg, registered with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register under number B 287514, advised by Vantrell Growth Equity ("VGE") (the "Investor" or "Vantrell");

(3) Mr. Wouter Desloovere, residing at Kapellestraat 63, 9860 Oosterzele (the "Founder"),

(together the "Shareholders"), and

(4) ZWALMVELD BIOPLASTICS NV, a naamloze vennootschap with registered office at Ottergemsesteenweg-Zuid 812, 9000 Ghent, registered with the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises under number 0803.257.493 (the "Company").

1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 In this Agreement:

"Code" means the Belgian Companies and Associations Code;

"Expert" means Verbiest & Callewaert Bedrijfsrevisoren BV or such other member of the Institute of Registered Auditors (IBR/IRE) as Vlietmolen and the Investor agree;

"Project Halyard" means the entry of Vlietmolen and the Investor into the capital of the Company under this Agreement;

"Reserved Matters" means the matters listed in Schedule 3.

2. SHARE CAPITAL AND CONTRIBUTIONS

2.1 At Completion the share capital shall be EUR 24,000,000, divided into 24,000 registered shares: Vlietmolen 12,000 (50%), the Investor 9,600 (40%), the Founder 2,400 (10%).

2.2 The Investor shall pay EUR 9,600,000 and Vlietmolen EUR 7,200,000 in cash, within five Business Days of Completion, to the Company's blocked capital account with KBC, IBAN BE73 7350 2914 6060, opened under Article 7:195 of the Code. Vlietmolen shall further contribute the extrusion line in Schedule 4 at EUR 4,800,000, as confirmed in the Expert's report under Article 7:197 of the Code.

2.3 The Founder's shares are issued against the contribution in kind of the Halyard know-how and the domain name zwalmveld.example.be.

3. BOARD OF DIRECTORS

3.1 The board comprises six directors: two Vlietmolen Directors (Ms. Griet Vanhoutteghem and Mr. Bavo Coussement), two Investor Directors (Ms. Ffion Rhydderch and Dr. Tobias Wendland), the Founder Director (Mr. Wouter Desloovere, also managing director, gedelegeerd bestuurder) and an independent chair (Prof. Marijke Blanckaert), jointly nominated by Vlietmolen and the Investor, without casting vote.

4. RESERVED MATTERS

4.1 The Company shall not undertake any Reserved Matter without the prior written approval of Vlietmolen and the Investor, including (a) capital expenditure above EUR 1,350,000 outside the approved budget, (b) borrowings above EUR 2,750,000 and (c) any transaction with a Shareholder or its affiliates.

5. DEADLOCK AND EXPERT DETERMINATION

5.1 If a Reserved Matter is rejected at two consecutive meetings, a Deadlock arises, which Vlietmolen or the Investor may refer to the senior partner of VGE and the chief executive officer of Vlietmolen.

5.2 Failing resolution within thirty Business Days, Vlietmolen may call all of the Investor's shares and the Investor may put all of its shares to Vlietmolen, in each case at Fair Value.

5.3 Fair Value is determined by the Expert as expert, not arbitrator (bindende derdenbeslissing), within thirty Business Days; its determination is final save for manifest error.

6. TRANSFER RESTRICTIONS

6.1 No Shareholder shall transfer shares before 31 December 2029 (the "Lock-up Period") save to an affiliate under Schedule 6 or under Clauses 5 and 7; a transfer in breach is unenforceable against the Company under Article 7:78 of the Code.

7. TAG-ALONG AND DRAG-ALONG

7.1 If Vlietmolen or the Investor proposes to transfer more than 25% of the share capital to a bona fide third party, the other Shareholders, including the Founder, may require the transferee to acquire their shares pro rata on the same terms.

7.2 Shareholders holding at least 75% of the share capital who accept a bona fide offer for all shares after the Lock-up Period may require the remaining Shareholders to sell on the same terms, at no less than Fair Value.

8. CONDITION — MERGER CONTROL

8.1 Completion is conditional on the European Commission declaring the formation of Zwalmveld Bioplastics NV as a full-function joint venture, notified under Article 4 of Regulation (EC) No 139/2004 on 27 August 2026, compatible with the internal market under Article 6(1)(b) (the "Condition"). Failing satisfaction by 18 March 2027, Vlietmolen or the Investor may terminate this Agreement.

9. NOTICES

9.1 Notices shall be given by hand, registered post or email to:

(a) Vlietmolen: registered office, attention General Counsel (legal@vlietmolen.example.be; +32 56 22 81 39);

(b) the Investor: Vantrell Plastics Holdco S.à r.l., 63, boulevard Grande-Duchesse Charlotte, L-1331 Luxembourg, attention Ms. Rhydderch (f.rhydderch@vantrell-ge.example.lu; +352 26 44 91 53);

(c) the Founder: Mr. Desloovere, private address above (w.desloovere@zwalmveld.example.be; +32 477 63 18 24);

(d) the Company: Ottergemsesteenweg-Zuid 812, 9000 Ghent, attention the chair (+32 9 331 46 72).

10. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION

10.1 Belgian law governs this Agreement. Disputes not subject to Clause 5 fall within the exclusive jurisdiction of the Enterprise Court of Brussels (Dutch-speaking division).

SIGNED in four originals.

For VLIETMOLEN POLYMERS NV: Ms. Griet Vanhoutteghem, CEO, and Mr. Bavo Coussement, CFO

For VANTRELL PLASTICS HOLDCO S.à r.l.: Ms. Ffion Rhydderch, Class A Manager, and Dr. Tobias Wendland, Class B Manager

The Founder: Wouter Desloovere

For ZWALMVELD BIOPLASTICS NV: Prof. Marijke Blanckaert, Chair

Drafted by Tanghe Sabbe Advocaten BV, Kortrijksesteenweg 1027, 9051 Sint-Denijs-Westrem — our ref. TS/2026/HAL/0731 (Vereecke / Tanghe)
notes: Excerpt of a Belgian-law shareholders' agreement for a joint venture NV between an industrial shareholder, a fund investing through a Luxembourg S.à r.l. and a founder-manager.
